response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price, AVG(item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) AS per_invoice;

assumptions.assumption: The average line-item count covers every invoice that has at least one line item, including invoices whose prices are all NULL. The skipping of invoices with no mean applies only to the average of means, which AVG ignores for NULL means. Line items are counted as rows in Invoice_Line_Items, so each row counts once regardless of product_quantity.
